description.zh: 路由算法唯一键，可通过调用接口[ListLogicTableRouteConfig](~~363030~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The unique key of the routing algorithm. You can call the [ListLogicTableRouteConfig](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listlogictablerouteconfig) operation to query the unique key.

description.zh: 逻辑库的表ID，可通过调用接口[ListLogicTables](~~141875~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the logical table. You can call the [ListLogicTables](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listlogictables) operation to query the ID of the logical table.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuseractivetenant) operation to query the tenant ID.
